target.name: Element Invoice — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Connected "Order" to "Invoice" with Dependency. Tool stays active - add another relation or press Esc.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — Order → Invoice":
  - heading "Relation — Order → Invoice" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Generalization"
    - option "Realization"
    - option "Composition"
    - option "Aggregation"
    - option "Association"
    - option "Bidirectional"
    - option "Plain Assoc."
    - option "Dependency" [selected]
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "Order" [selected]
    - option "Customer"
    - option "Invoice"
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "Order"
    - option "Customer"
    - option "Invoice" [selected]
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label"
  - text: Stereotype
  - textbox "Stereotype"
  - button "Invert direction"
  - paragraph: Drag a line segment to reroute, or press Delete to remove this relation.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
